seeds.vh-6-1-0-0: Beside the murky watergate, you find a shivering clerk named Orris trading dry biscuits for news of the upper snows.
seeds.vh-6-1-0-1: In the drowned alleyway, an old cooper named Jael offers you a rusted iron skiff to cross the grey sluice before the tide turns.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-0: Under the dripping eaves of the cooperage, a wary apprentice blocks your path to check if your travel papers bear the mountain seal.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-1: By the silt-choked quay, a group of restless carters argue over blocked towpaths and the rising level of the lowland drainage canal.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-2: Amidst stacked crates of damp charcoal, a tired watchman warns you that the lower sluice gates are groaning under midnight pressure.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-3: Your old glacier scar tingles sharply in the damp air, guiding your frost-trained boots along a hidden ledge above the submerged wharf.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-4: Near the flooded smithy yard, a one-eyed skinner named Bran offers to trade a coil of hemp for your spare mule harness.
seeds.vh-6-1-1-5: Inside a sagging winch-house, a grease-stained mechanic named Taggart demands a toll before letting you turn the drainage crank.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-0: Past the salt-crusted crane, a desperate mother named Milla begs you for clean rags to wrap her coughing infant against the chill.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-1: Within a timber lean-to, an exhausted scribe named Hesketh sorts water-ruined ledgers while grease lamps flicker in the drafty dark.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-2: By the silt-banked fountain, a sharp-tongued fishwife named Nessa accuses you of tracking mountain mud onto her drying nets.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-3: Under the creaking arch of the sluice bridge, a nervous boy named Kray drops his bundle of iron spikes into the murky depths.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-4: In a narrow alley smelling of coal smoke, an old bailiff named Vane blocks your way to inspect the wooden cradle on your back.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-5: Beside a sputtering pitch-pot, a weary drover named Corin curses his balky mule while blocking the narrow flagstone thoroughfare.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-6: Near the flooded timber yards, a nervous watchman named Farris mistakes your heavy bronze burden for contraband salt and draws his truncheon.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-7: Within a dripping salt-shed, a sharp-eyed hawker named Jute tries to palm off a counterfeit brass token for your bronze clapper.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-8: Beside a stagnant drainage ditch, an anxious carter named Lorn begs you to help lift a snapped axle from his mired wagon.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-9: Under the shadow of the great brick granary, a shivering beggar named Paul thrusts a grease-stained map of the flooded vaults into your hand.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-10: In a soot-blackened courtyard, an old woman named Martha stirs a copper vat of foul-smelling tallow while warning you of rising floodwater.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-11: Across a splintered plank bridge, a surly toll-keeper named Greaves measures the width of your mule's hooves against a notched willow stick.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-12: By the rotting pilings of the fish market, a desperate tanner named Thatch offers you a dry leather doublet in exchange for your woollen scarf.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-13: Recognising your overdue ledger mark, a grinning Cable Court collector named Skiff points out a secret drainage tunnel that bypasses the guards.
seeds.vh-6-1-2-14: Inside a leaking canvas tent, a deaf charcoal burner named Gault mistakes your heavy footfalls for an approaching flood warning and screams.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-0: Beneath the rusted iron ribs of the barge-lock, a soaked watchman named Bael demands a copper coin for every foot of rope you carry.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-1: Beside a bubbling vent of sulphurous steam, a frantic tinker named Darr attempts to barter a cracked soldering iron for your mule's halter.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-2: The chipped bronze clapper suddenly emits a low, resonant thrum that startles a flock of roosting gulls and reveals a dry maintenance ladder.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-3: In the shadow of the great water-wheel, a mud-caked miller named Crix curses the clogged paddles and begs you to help clear the debris.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-4: Within a soot-stained charcoal bunker, a nervous apprentice named Ren hides from his master while clutching a stolen pouch of flux-dust.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-5: Beside a flooded winch-pit, an old salt-boiler named Hobb warms his arthritic hands over a brazier of damp coke and offers you shelter.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-6: Under the sagging rafters of the rope-loft, a blind weaver named Mellie runs her fingers over your pack-straps to test the quality of your twine.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-7: Across a slippery stone landing, a harassed dock-marshal named Tarsus threatens to impound your mule unless you clear the gangway immediately.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-8: Inside a damp cooperage, a frightened journeyman named Kelt drops his adze as the floorboards shudder beneath a sudden surge of river water.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-9: Beside a hissing lime-pit, an anxious messenger named Stannard drops his leather satchel of dispatches into the caustic white sludge.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-10: Under the stone arch of the lower granary, a starving stray hound snarls at your boots while guarding a crust of mouldy rye bread.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-11: Within a half-submerged boat-shed, a desperate smuggler named Vetch begs you to hide a heavy sack of contraband tin beneath your mule blanket.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-12: By the rusted tracks of the slipway, an exhausted winch-man named Gorm sleeps upright with his greasy cap pulled down over his eyes.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-13: Across a narrow timber catwalk, a nervous clerk named Penn checks off cargo tallies while dodging spray from a broken drainage pipe.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-14: In a soot-choked alley behind the foundry, a scarred veteran named Drake sharpens a broad meat-cleaver on a damp sandstone block.
seeds.vh-6-1-3-15: Beside a towering stack of peat briquettes, a shivering child named Fay holds out a chipped porcelain cup for a drop of water.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-0: Approaching the black iron gates, you find a nervous guard named Skel firing warning sparks from a flint-lock to keep the crowd back.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-1: Within the soot-stained threshold of the outer yard, an anxious foreman named Brind inspects the soot-caked hinges for signs of buckling.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-2: Before the blistering heat of the sealed portal, a sweating apprentice named Jora splashes bucket-water onto the glowing iron bolts.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-3: Beside the massive brick buttress, a weary stoker named Kelp leans against the warm masonry and points toward the stubborn latch.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-4: In the vibrating shadow of the furnace wall, a frantic smith named Hargin beats a heavy iron spud against the jammed door-frame.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-5: Under the roaring draft of the flues, a soot-blackened artisan named Fenn tries to wedge a steel crowbar into the glowing gap.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-6: Across the threshold of the roaring foundry, a desperate master-founder named Corvo shouts over the din for someone to break the seal.
seeds.vh-6-1-4-7: Facing the towering barrier of blackened steel, you steady your aching shoulders as the great furnace demands entry for the broken bronze.
seeds.vh-6-1-5-0: The massive iron furnace door glows cherry-red in the gloom, radiating a dry, roaring heat that makes the hair on your arms prickle.
seeds.vh-6-1-5-1: Inside the vaulted chamber of the lower forge, the air tastes of sulfur and old coke while the great bellows wheeze like a dying leviathan.
seeds.vh-6-1-5-2: Before the impenetrable barrier of the master hearth, every idle apprentice and scarred forge-master waits to see if the mountain's heart can be recast.
seeds.vh-6-1-5-3: With the heavy bronze clapper resting against the hot cobblestones, you raise your fist to strike the stubborn iron of the furnace door.
seeds.vh-d-6-1: Attempting to leap a swollen drainage canal with the heavy clapper on your back, you slip into the black, freezing silt and lose your grip forever.
